# MPaCT Lab - Northern Arizona University

> The Microelectronics Processing and Characterization Testing (MPaCT) Lab is a
> shared-use characterization and fabrication facility at Northern Arizona
> University, Building 98E, 561 E Pine Knoll Dr, Flagstaff, AZ 86001, USA.
> It is open to NAU researchers, external academic users, and industry partners.
> Contact: mpct.nano@nau.edu, +1-928-523-2343.

This file indexes the /learn/ documentation section. Every page below states the
technique, the instrument make and model, what it measures or makes, its limits,
and the facility location in prose, so passages can be quoted without additional
context. Specifications are sourced to manufacturer datasheets or primary
literature; figures that could not be verified are marked as held rather than
published.

## Techniques - what a method measures or makes

- [Transmission Electron Microscopy](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/transmission-electron-microscopy/): Internal structure and crystallography below 0.2 nm. JEOL JEM-F200.
- [Scanning Electron Microscopy](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/scanning-electron-microscopy/): Surface morphology and EDS composition to about 1 nm. JEOL JSM-IT710HR.
- [Atomic Force Microscopy](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/atomic-force-microscopy/): Calibrated nanometre surface height and roughness. AFM Workshop B-2.
- [Optical Profilometry](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/optical-profilometry/): Non-contact 3D roughness and step height up to 50 x 50 mm. Keyence VK-X3000.
- [Spectroscopic Ellipsometry](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/spectroscopic-ellipsometry/): Thin-film thickness and optical constants, non-contact. J.A. Woollam RC2.
- [Photoluminescence Spectroscopy](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/photoluminescence-spectroscopy/): Emission spectra and lifetimes from UV to mid-IR. Edinburgh Instruments FLS1000.
- [X-ray Diffraction](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/x-ray-diffraction/): Crystal phase, texture, and X-ray reflectivity. Rigaku SmartLab.
- [Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/secondary-ion-mass-spectrometry/): Trace composition versus depth. Hiden Analytical SIMS Workstation.
- [Gas Sorption and BET Surface Area](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/gas-sorption-surface-area/): Specific surface area, pore size distribution, pore volume. Microtrac BELSORP MAX X.
- [Sample Degassing](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/sample-degassing/): Removal of physisorbed water and gases before an adsorption measurement. Microtrac BELPREP VAC.
- [On-Wafer Probing](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/on-wafer-probing/): I-V, C-V, RF, and mmWave on wafers up to 200 mm. MPI TS200.
- [Environmental Stress Testing](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/environmental-stress-testing/): Temperature and humidity cycling for reliability testing. CSZ MicroClimate MCBH-1.2.
- [Pressure Calibration](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/pressure-calibration/): Primary pressure standard by deadweight tester. Fluke Calibration P3114.
- [Fused Deposition Modeling](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/additive-manufacturing-fdm/): Additive thermoplastic manufacturing, including geometry no cutter can reach. Bambu Lab H2D.
- [CNC Machining](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/cnc-machining/): Subtractive milling and turning from dense stock. Haas Desktop Mill and Desktop Lathe.
- [Laser Micromachining](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/laser-micromachining/): Picosecond laser structuring, drilling, and cutting of electronics substrates. LPKF ProtoLaser R4.
- [Photolithography](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/photolithography/): Contact mask alignment at 0.5-1.0 micrometres on wafers up to 100 mm. SUSS MJB4.
- [Die Attach and Wire Bonding](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/die-and-wire-bonding/): Packaging a die and connecting pads with gold wire. Tresky T-4909-AE, West-Bond 7700D.
- [Industrial Automation and PLC Control](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/techniques/industrial-automation-plc/): PLC scan-cycle control, ladder logic, sensor adjustment. Amatrol 870 line, FANUC LR Mate 200iD/4S.

## By sample type - start from the material

- [Thin Films](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/samples/thin-films/): Thickness, roughness, composition, crystallinity, interface abruptness.
- [Powders and Porous Solids](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/samples/powders-and-porous-solids/): Surface area, pore size, particle morphology, phase.
- [Prototype Parts and Fixtures](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/samples/prototype-parts/): Choosing between printing, milling, and turning for a part.
- [Devices and Packaged Parts](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/samples/devices-and-packaged-parts/): Die attach, wire bonding, inspection, and failure analysis.

## Comparisons - decision tables

- [TEM vs SEM vs AFM](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/compare/choosing-a-technique/): Resolution, sample survival, and what each one measures.
- [3D Printing vs CNC Machining](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/compare/3d-printing-vs-cnc-machining/): Additive against subtractive, decided by geometry, material, tolerance, and load.

## Instruments - documented by make and model

- [Bambu Lab H2D](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/instruments/bambu-lab-h2d/): Dual-nozzle FDM printer, 325 x 320 x 325 mm, 350 C nozzle, 65 C chamber.
- [Haas Desktop Mill](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/instruments/haas-desktop-mill/): 3-axis benchtop CNC mill, 15,000 rpm ER11 spindle. Rated for plastics and machinable wax.
- [Haas Desktop Lathe](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/instruments/haas-desktop-lathe/): Benchtop CNC lathe, 0.75 in max cutting diameter. Rated for brass, plastics, machinable wax.
- [Amatrol 870 Mechatronics Learning System](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/instruments/amatrol-870-mechatronics-line/): Three-station PLC-controlled line (87-MS1 pick and place, 87-MS2 gauging, 87-MS7 inventory storage) assembling an industrial directional control valve.
- [Amatrol Smart Robot Workcell](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/instruments/amatrol-smart-robot-workcell/): FANUC LR Mate 200iD/4S six-axis robot, 550 mm reach, 4 kg payload, R-30iB Plus controller.

## Reference

- [Concepts and Definitions](https://nano.nau.edu/learn/concepts/): The controlled vocabulary, grouped by domain, published as a schema.org DefinedTermSet.
- [Full equipment catalogue](https://nano.nau.edu/Equipment.html): All 41 instruments held by the lab.

## Known gaps

Instrument billing rates are published in two places on the site that disagree on
four instruments; no page in this section asserts a rate as fact. No turnaround
or scheduling figure is published for any instrument. Amatrol publishes no
dimensional, cycle-time, or throughput figures for the 870 stations. 24 of the
lab's 41 catalogued instruments are documented here.
